intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Chandigarh University vs Chitkara University is not a single winner. Chandigarh University holds NIRF 2025 #32 on our records, and Chitkara University holds NIRF 2025 #78.

sections.heading: Chandigarh University vs Chitkara University for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Chandigarh University if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #32, and a 2022 flagship package record of ₹28 LPA, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Chandigarh.
Choose Chitkara University if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #78, and a 2022 flagship package record of ₹6 LPA, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Chandigarh.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹1.57 lakh as a programme total for MBA at Chandigarh University.

Our records show ₹2.8 lakh as a tuition figure for MBA Banking Finance and Insurance Services Management at Chitkara University. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Chandigarh University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2022, with a highest package of ₹28 LPA on MBA Digital Marketing. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

Chitkara University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2022, with an average of ₹6 LPA and a highest package of ₹11 LPA on MBA Banking Finance and Insurance Services Management. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Chandigarh University is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Chitkara University is listed on our records with CAT, NMAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Punjab. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If ranks and the wider recruiter mix matter most, Chandigarh University is the stronger recorded option on this page, with NIRF 2025 #32 against NIRF 2025 #78.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Chitkara University's recorded ₹2.8 lakh or Chandigarh University's ₹1.57 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Chandigarh University or Chitkara University?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Chandigarh University and Chitkara University differ in more than one way: Chandigarh University holds NIRF 2025 #32 on our records, while Chitkara University holds NIRF 2025 #78.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Chandigarh University vs Chitkara University?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹1.57 lakh for Chandigarh University on MBA; our records list ₹2.8 lakh for Chitkara University on MBA Banking Finance and Insurance Services Management. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Chandigarh University and Chitkara University?
faqs.answer: Chandigarh University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2022, with a highest package of ₹28 LPA on MBA Digital Marketing. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Chandigarh University and Chitkara University accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CAT for Chandigarh University, and CAT, NMAT for Chitkara University. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Chandigarh University and Chitkara University in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Chandigarh, Punjab. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
